definitions.gloss: economy size, economical, bargain, good value
definitions.explanation: Describes products sold in larger quantities at a lower per-unit price. Used for consumer goods like food, household supplies, and everyday items. Often written as お{徳用|とくよう}.

examples.japanese: お{徳用|とくよう}⟦パック→パック：11002_pakku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
{徳用|とくよう}⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦お{得|とく}→お得：07739_otoku⟧だ。
examples.english: Economy-size detergent is a good deal.

examples.japanese: お{徳用|とくよう}⟦{海苔|のり}→海苔：10391_nori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: The economy-size seaweed has a lot of quantity and is convenient for family use.

notes:
{徳用|とくよう} means economy-size or good value. It is very commonly seen on product packaging as お{徳用|とくよう}, with the polite prefix お.

NOTE ON KANJI:
Also written as {得用|とくよう} using the kanji for 'gain/profit.' Both ⟦{徳|とく}→徳：23014_toku⟧ and ⟦{得|とく}→得：12563_toku⟧ are used, though {徳用|とくよう} is the traditional form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{徳用|とくよう}⟦パック→パック：11002_pakku⟧: economy pack
- お{徳用|とくよう}⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧: economy size
- {徳用|とくよう}{袋|ぶくろ}: bargain bag

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{得|とく}→お得：07739_otoku⟧: bargain, good deal (more casual)
- ⟦{大容量|だいようりょう}→大容量：19805_daiyouryou⟧: large capacity
- ⟦{業務用|ぎょうむよう}→業務用：13148_gyoumuyou⟧: commercial/bulk size
